items.title: Amara La Negra on VH1’s LOVE & HIP HOP: MIAMI
items.description: VH1’s LOVE & HIP HOP: MIAMI is returning for a whole new season and the stakes have never been higher! Breakout series star, Amara La Negra dishes on what to expect this season as well as her music, acting, and podcast career on PCTV.

items.title: The King-Dom Podcast featuring Trina
items.description: In honor of Black Business Month coming up in August, I sat down with Liberty City’s own Trina—rap icon, entrepreneur, and changemaker—for a powerful conversation about building legacy, owning your story, and staying rooted in community. We reflect on the 25th anniversary of her album Da Baddest Bit

items.title: Sunday Flashback! Black Student Union, Gunplay, & Tiffany "New York" Pollard!
items.description:
On this Sunday Flashback, Jesse interviews the Antelope Valley College Black Student Union President, rapper Gunplay (aka Don Logan), and Tiffany "New York" Pollard (from "Flavor of Love" and "I Love New York"). The theme is: black men and women.

items.title: “Love & Hip Hop” Star Amara La Negra Is Calling Out Racism — And Colorism
items.description:
It's a scene all too common in the entertainment industry: A male producer tells a female musician she needs to change her appearance in order to be successful.

This time, when the interaction unfolded during the premiere of VH1's "Love & Hip Hop: Miami" on Jan. 1, the female artist pushed back.
